title: Writing a Linear Model
text: Translate the given information into $$2$$ linear models.

hintAnswer: Set the equations equal to each other.
title: Compare Models
text: To answer this problem, we need to find when our $$2$$ models intersect. What should I do if I want to find when (what amount of minutes) one model equals the other?
choices: Set the equations equal to each other.

title: Interpret
text: Interpret each model. Because the slope is larger in $$y=5x$$, the line is steeper and the slope in $$y=3x+40$$ is less steep, but starts at $$40$$ instead of $$0$$. Therefore, $$y=5x$$ will be more expensive for a large enough $$x$$.

title: Interpret
text: We are interested in the cheapest model and the value of $$x$$ is when $$y=3x+40$$ is the better choice. $$x$$ is our answer.
